{{Quote|The missiles produced on Cademimu are supposed to supply planetary defense batteries along the Celanon Spur, a major trade route. Those worlds now lie vulnerable.|[[Satele Shan]] during the [[Cademimu uprising]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Celanon Spur''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that connected [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]], an important [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Galactic economy|trade]] world, to the surrounding area.
